## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* sectional-analysis (*kē* 科) navigational apparatus to [大義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A7%E7%BE%A9) Dàyì's *Fǎhuá jīng dàchéng* ([KR6d0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0085), X32n0619, 10 *juan*), compiled by [際慶](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9A%9B%E6%85%B6) Jìqìng of the **Jìnníng Guǎngjìsì** 晉寧廣濟寺 in modern Yúnnán. The preface by [惟鉉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%83%9F%E9%89%89) Wéixuán dates the work to Kāngxī 丙戌 (= 1706 CE).

**Abstract**

The *Dàchéng kē* is the structural-outline navigational apparatus to Dàyì's *Dàchéng* ([KR6d0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0085)), produced concurrently with or shortly after the *Dàchéng* itself for use in monastic and lay study. Its compilation in 1706 establishes a *terminus ante quem* of 1706 for the completion of Dàyì's *Dàchéng* — a useful constraint for dating Dàyì's productive activity, which according to his own *Biānjí shǐmò* (compilation history) extended through 1736 for the final consolidation of the *Dàchéng*'s ten *juan*.

The pairing of [KR6d0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0085) (the *Dàchéng*) with [KR6d0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0084) (its *kē*) and [KR6d0086](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0086) (its *yīnyì*, phonetic-and-meaning glossary) demonstrates the systematic late-Kāngxī editorial practice of providing complete navigational apparatus for major commentarial productions — a continuation of the Sòng tradition observed in [KR6d0061](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0061) and elsewhere.
